fields.description_1: Fidelyaa supports government organisations and SMEs with strategic advice, guidance, reintegration and activation programmes, tenders, analysis and implementation support. The website needed to make those different consultancy routes understandable without flattening them into one generic advisory service.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress presentation around the main advisory and programme areas, with enough context to show where strategy, guidance and implementation differ. Clear contact routes help organisations move from a specific challenge to a relevant conversation.

fields.description_1: Content Sync Manager is a WordPress content workflow for exporting, reviewing and importing structured updates across pages, posts, products and custom content. It brings ACF fields, summaries, SEO text and media-related information into a reviewable format instead of spreading changes across separate editing screens.
fields.description_2: I built the workflow around structured exports, controlled review and validated imports that preserve existing content and media unless an administrator intentionally changes them. This makes larger content updates easier to inspect before WordPress writes are processed.

fields.description_1: The WooCommerce Egaline Calculator turns surface area, layer thickness and product configuration into a practical material calculation for flooring products. The plugin needed to connect quantity calculation and live pricing directly to the product journey rather than describe an abstract internal workflow.
fields.description_2: I built the WooCommerce flow so customers can enter project measurements, calculate the required quantity and continue with the correct product amount and price. Support for product variations, discounts and cart metadata keeps the calculation connected to the actual order.

fields.description_1: Overview of Services Manager gives WordPress sites a structured service catalogue instead of maintaining scattered manual lists. Services can be organised with categories, summaries, prices and related data so administrators can keep the offer consistent as it grows.
fields.description_2: I built the plugin around a dedicated service content model with frontend filtering and CSV import or export. This gives administrators one maintainable source for service data while visitors get a clearer, searchable overview of the offer.

fields.description_1: Sparx Entertainment Agency offers entertainment for weddings, birthdays and corporate events, including DJs, live musicians, bands, special acts and event extras. The website needed to make that broad entertainment catalogue easy to explore while keeping booking and enquiry practical.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around entertainment types and event needs, letting visitors move from DJs or live artists into more specific acts and supporting extras. Clear enquiry routes stay close to the relevant options so the site works as both inspiration and a booking-oriented portfolio.

fields.description_1: Managing multilingual WordPress content can quickly become fragmented when languages, translated strings, SEO details, review status and import or export tasks sit in different places. The project needed one structured admin workflow for tracking and reviewing translation work.
fields.description_2: The translation plugin brings language configuration, content scanning, translation status, CSV import and export and a frontend language switcher into one WordPress workflow. This keeps editorial review and visitor language access connected without relying on scattered manual steps.
